semantics.reset: active high synchronous: q becomes 1 at a rising edge with reset high
semantics.count: on each rising edge without reset, advance through 1..10 inclusive and wrap 10 to 1
semantics.between_edges: q holds; reset changes alone do not change q
semantics.initialization: original problem gives no power-up value; no initialization added and tests require defined behavior only after reset

verification.oracle: independent integer sequence derived from original problem
verification.sampling: check after rising-edge nonblocking updates; check hold at falling edge and reset transitions
verification.cases: repeated full cycles, all legal values, 10-to-1 wrap, held reset, reset during count including at 10, reset pulse without rising edge
verification.termination: fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, explicit PASS

specification_ambiguities: Power-up q and behavior from illegal states 0 or 11..15 are unspecified; no recovery requirement or test expectation is imposed.
